pages.title: Black Caiman
pages.text: The black caiman ($(o)Melanosuchus niger$()) is the largest predator of the Amazon basin.$(br2)It is almost black, with pale grey bands on its jaws and flanks, and hunts capybaras, fish and other animals at night.$(br2)It was once hunted almost to extinction for its skin, and has since recovered.
